Row 3: timber-framed rocky mine entrance; scholarly academy tower; small market stall with cream canopy and baskets; woodland shrine with golden sun medallion.
Row 4: observatory with brass telescope and rounded green dome; small cozy brick factory with twin chimneys; whimsical compact rocket on wooden launchpad; mystical stone time gate with glowing teal central portal.
Each object centered at the equal-grid cell center; aligned ground baseline within every cell. Absolutely no extra sprites, labels, text, connected backdrops, gradients outside objects, borders or grid lines. True transparent background.
